{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-verify the data after parsing revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for any invalid revenue values (e.g., NaN or negative)
invalid_revenue = sales_df[~sales_df['revenue'].apply(lambda x: pd.notna(x) and x >= 0)]

# Check the count of completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed_count = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
].shape[0]

# Check for any negative or zero revenue in loyal completed orders
loyal_completed = sales_df[
    (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')
]
zero_or_negative_revenue = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] <= 0]

invalid_revenue.shape[0], loyal_completed_count, zero_or_negative_revenue.shape[0]"}
